correctness.rationale: All proper simple games through five players are exhaustively generated from minimal-winning antichains. Two exact formulations agree for Deegan–Packel and two for Johnston. value.rationale: Deegan–Packel and Johnston are classical power indices that the literature directly studies as a pair, but they allocate coalition influence by different mechanisms. The smallest proper game where that difference changes ordinal power is therefore a natural structural invariant. The exact first layer is substantial: 940 labeled games, 18 symmetry classes, and a clean nine-class/nine-class split between tie refinement and genuine strict reversal.
